description: Create, translate, and plan Cookidoo recipes with guided Thermomix actions and shopping lists.
name: io.github.vitaliemiron/cookidoo-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Cookidoo login identifier; required unless supplied through --env-file.
environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Cookidoo password; required unless supplied through --env-file.
environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Optional two-letter Cookidoo country code; defaults to ro.
environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_COUNTRY

environmentVariables.description: Optional Cookidoo language tag for the selected country; defaults to en.
environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOO_LANGUAGE

packageArguments.description: Optional local .env file containing Cookidoo credentials and locale settings.
packageArguments.name: --env-file

title: Cookidoo MCP
